title: A day at my school
instructions: Sofia okuldaki bir gününü anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; saatlere ve derslere dikkat et.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: Hello! My name is Sofia and I am eleven years old.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: I go to Green Park School.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: It is a big school with three hundred students.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: My school starts at half past eight.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: I walk to school with my brother, Leo.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: My first lesson is maths. I don't like maths very much.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: My favourite lesson is art. I love drawing and painting.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: Our art teacher is Mister Brown. He is very funny.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: At eleven o'clock, we have a break.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: I eat a sandwich and drink some water.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: We have lunch at one o'clock in the big dining room.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: After lunch, we have English and music.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: School finishes at half past three.

script.speaker: sofia
script.text: Then I go home and do my homework.

questions.prompt: How does Sofia go to school?
questions.feedback: "Walk" yürümek demek. Sofia okula kardeşi Leo ile yürüyerek (on foot) gidiyor.
questions.evidence: I walk to school with my brother, Leo.

questions.feedback: En sevdiği ders resim (art). Matematik ilk dersi ama onu pek sevmiyor (don't like).
Okul üç buçukta (half past three) bitiyor. Sekiz buçuk başlama, on bir teneffüs, bir öğle yemeği saati.
questions.evidence: School finishes at half past three.
